general.description: Extremely hardy photosynthetic organisms adapted to arid environments. They use waxy leaves for protection, can enter hibernation by sealing off atmospheric exchange, and funnel precipitation to internal storage via specialized cells.

color_variants.rule: Color depends on parent star type

Aleoida arcus.description: Upright clumps of long serrated leaves that open to reveal seed-containing reproductive organs.

Aleoida coronamus.description: Interleaved crown of mottled leaves with explosive seed pods on protruding stalks.

Aleoida gravis.description: Large organism with wide flat leaves on a heavy base and a dome-shaped reproductive organ.

Aleoida laminiae.description: Circular arrangement of patterned leaves around a central fleshy pod.

Aleoida spica.description: Tall spiky leaves surrounding a central reproductive stalk.
